<solution task="t0-even-odd">
ohetdi even = 0.
ohetdi odd = 0.
ohetdi line = nilhino().
konit line <> emletlel mitho nethe

    rilniro (n kolethul 2) == 0 hutro nethe
        even = even + 1.
    dit thumku nethe
        odd = odd + 1.
    dit
    line = nilhino().
dit

miyol "odd " & odd.
